artifacts.summary: Root-caused gate 5's 3 false positives to verify.lua's per-extension-only hash comparison (verify_manifest_category/walk_category_leaves, called independently per loaded extension by manager.verify_all), with no cross-extension ownership resolution for manifest paths two active extensions both declare (core + lean both declare context/contracts). Reproduced live, confirmed deployed files byte-match lean's deliberate override, identified lean-wins-via-dependency-topological-load-order as the real deploy semantics (reused by manager.resync_all's inlined Kahn's algorithm), and recommended an owner-resolution fix in verify.lua/init.lua plus a simpler matches-any-declarer fallback. Also confirmed and scoped the secondary gate-16 misleading-hint finding (hard_contracts is not a migration target for routing_hard/routing_agents_hard per manifest-routing-schema.md; backlog shows outright removal is the real future, not a key rename).

next_steps: Run /plan 290 to design the gate-5 owner-resolution fix (verify.lua + init.lua) and the gate-16 hint-text correction
